items.claim: The 7:10/7:12 extent holds on form, but the close-near boundary_evidence_ref locates the end of the charge at the wrong clause: it names the clause rp:1Cor.7.11 «μενέτω ἄγαμος» as the end, while in 7:11 that clause opens the parenthetical exception and the charge closes with rp:1Cor.7.11 «καὶ ἄνδρα γυναῖκα μὴ ἀφιέναι» at verse end. Because μενέτω is also the chapter's refrain verb (strategy §2), the wording risks reading an exception clause as a closing refrain. Separately, the §7 F REPORTED divided reading on divorce and the Pauline privilege at 7:10-7:16 is not named on this row.
